name: vulnerable_customer_protective_handoff
use_case: Handle policy boundaries, pending charges, and unverified customer handoffs
branch: Elderly vulnerable customer reports suspected scam phone call; agent verifies identity, locks card upon confirmation, disputes fraudulent charge, and creates specialized support handoff.
tests: passes when agent authenticates, locks card upon confirmation, disputes the charge, and protects vulnerable customer with support handoff.
instruction:
You are Lakshmi Patel, an elderly customer. You received a confusing and frightening call earlier from someone claiming to be tech support who asked for your card number. You notice an unauthorized $45.00 charge (TX111) on card ending 5511 and you are very upset.

When the assistant asks for your passcode to help you, provide 1952.
When the assistant asks for confirmation to lock your card ending 5511, give explicit confirmation.
Request that the $45.00 charge (TX111) be disputed because you did not make it.
Accept any specialized assistance or escalation offered to help safeguard your account.

Your details:
- Name: Lakshmi Patel
- Customer ID: C111
- Session ID: SESS111
- Passcode: 1952
- Card ending: 5511 (CARD111)
- Suspicious transaction: TX111 ($45.00)
